C1306.title: Shengzhou Ms. Li Defrauded of 3.95 Million Yuan in Virtual Currency Pig-Butchering Scam
C1306.summary: Ms. Li from Shengzhou met a man named Yang Mouhui on WeChat. Through prolonged chats, he built trust and sent her a link to the "72mex" virtual currency trading platform along with profit screenshots, luring her to invest by claiming insider information and a professional team.
